wholePhysicalScope: The former Hospital Colônia de Barbacena main building, including the publicly accessible Museu da Loucura in the Torreão and the attached ranges around its six mapped courts.
lodDetails: All four levels retain the museum tower, curved frontage, attached tiled ranges and open courts. Near views add opening profiles, brick trim, divided panes and individual entrance steps.
limitations: The connected exterior and six open courts are based on the native mapped building. The museum lies at the rounded northeastern projection.

The 1921 archive documents a tiled pavilion on the grounds. The tower itself is based on the official museum identity, the two-storey description and the mapped plan. Roof breaks, exterior finishes, tower crown and opening details are estimated.
The historic model covers the main connected building and its museum wing. Finished architectural levels, exact thresholds and grade contact are approximations.
